clusters.name: Platform Integration
clusters.reason: Migration of front-end applications to the Accxui framework, aligning state management with Pinia, refactoring bundlers to Vite, and standardizing Shopify-based login flows.

clusters.name: Application Versioning
clusters.reason: Introduction of URL-based version routing support to handle multiple live application builds requested directly by the Order Management System.

clusters.name: Framework Migration
clusters.reason: Backend framework transitions refactoring services and APIs from legacy Apache OFBiz implementations to Moqui counterparts.

clusters.name: Concurrency Control
clusters.reason: Establishment of robust row locks and status-transition gates preventing concurrent submissions from producing duplicate receipts and inventory duplication during partial or complete receiving processes.

clusters.name: Access Control
clusters.reason: Standardization of system permissions to gate user interfaces and restrict business operations like shipping, unpacking, and bulk transfers based on assigned security groups.

clusters.name: Attribute Management
clusters.reason: Deployment of write APIs and bulk upsert operations to allow the seamless addition and editing of attributes at both the order and order line-item levels.

clusters.name: User Provisioning
clusters.reason: Refactoring of user search synchronization, profile content models, and transitions to Moqui UserAccount configurations for bootstrap and operational roles.

clusters.name: Hold Queue Management
clusters.reason: Introduction of unified order hold tasks and life cycle auto-resolution rules to ensure that hold/review tasks automatically cancel when orders are closed.

clusters.name: Delivery Estimation
clusters.reason: Calculations establishing estimated ship dates and delivery dates for groups requiring fulfillment, utilizing facility SLA times and carrier configurations.

clusters.name: Customer Communications
clusters.reason: Upgrades to customer notification event payloads including carrier tracking links, fulfillment store identifiers, and dynamic URLs specifically for order updates.

clusters.name: Dashboard Analytics
clusters.reason: API adjustments that correct the collection and deduplication of warehouse metric metrics on the dashboard funnels.

clusters.name: Performance Optimization
clusters.reason: Optimizations target bottlenecks in rendering loops and identical database operations by substituting map lookups and memoizing frequently fetched data structures.

clusters.name: Token Management
clusters.reason: Relocation of FCM and client registration token destruction to pre-logout workflows to resolve permission failures on user sign-out.

clusters.name: Moqui Authentication
clusters.reason: Adjustments supporting system actions, cookie parameters, and permission fetches within moqui-only login environments.

clusters.name: Search Integration
clusters.reason: Routing adjustments aligning frontend product and store queries with specific Maarg-compatible Solr lookup endpoints.

clusters.name: User Interface Layout
clusters.reason: Front-end refinements correcting card borders, item separators, and product list grids on mobile and desktop devices.

clusters.name: Picklist Generation
clusters.reason: Integration of unified PDF generation actions and store settings resolving failure bugs on picking workflows.

clusters.name: Navigation Shortcut
clusters.reason: Integration of the Fast Travel search utility component inside the Transfers application shell.

clusters.name: Product Selection
clusters.reason: Filtering product searches during manual inventory transfer setups to retrieve only product variants.

clusters.name: Exchange Order Association
clusters.reason: API enhancements exposing bidirectional relationships on exchange order item connections via the orders resource.

clusters.name: Search Indexing Authentication
clusters.reason: Addition of authorization bypass attributes to background order and item re-indexing processes triggered after database updates.

clusters.name: Job Monitoring
clusters.reason: Introduction of visual markers highlighting instances where automated jobs have crashed or failed to restart.

clusters.name: Order Item Cancellation
clusters.reason: Standardization of the response envelope during order item cancellations to return real cancelled items instead of system-level reservations.

clusters.name: Security Compliance
clusters.reason: Removal of broad service execution dumps to prevent sensitive user information leaking into server logging platforms.

clusters.name: Purchase Orders
clusters.reason: Addition of generic setup services and response alignments supporting purchase order details on listings.

clusters.name: Order Processing
clusters.reason: Resolution of checkout bugs mapping billing party identifications to order headers unconditionally.

clusters.name: Fulfillment Mapping
clusters.reason: Extension of the ship group database model with identifiers allowing accurate synchronization with external Shopify groups.

clusters.name: Inventory Reservation
clusters.reason: Automation of physical item reservations on order approvals via a system service execution trigger.

clusters.name: Inventory History
clusters.reason: Implementation of manual inventory variance endpoints assisting history lookups.

clusters.name: Store Configuration APIs
clusters.reason: Deployment of REST write and fetch resources representing carrier methods, gateway details, and payment typologies.
